'''2009 Bespin Regionals Adam Howland LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' T.I.G.I.H.A.N.
* '''Username:''' MasterJediAdam
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
